articles.summary: Mission Produce, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVO) (“Mission” or “the Company”) a world leader in sourcing, producing, and distributing fresh Hass avocados, today announced a planned leadership transition: Steve Barnard, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer, will assume the role of Executive Chairman of the Board, and John Pawlowski, currently President and Chief Operating Officer, will become Chief Executive Officer, effective at the close of the Company’s Annual Meeting of Shareholders in April 2026. The announcement reflects Mission’s long-term succession planning and the strength of its operational bench in avocados and mangos across retail, wholesale, and foodservice channels.
articles.title: Mission Produce® Announces Leadership Succession: Co-founder & CEO Steve Barnard to Become Executive Chairman; President & COO John Pawlowski Named CEO
